purpose: Motion-refresh variant: reduce static overhead by using a longer cache interval, a higher motion threshold, and far-loss refresh only.
expected_effect: Preserve cached stereo rough distance while reducing refresh frequency.
Avoid unknown-spike refresh because FarBackground fallback often keeps unknown near zero.
Use far-loss as the main semantic recovery trigger.
risk: May refresh too late during slow motion.
Needs slow_pan_far_object and hand_occlusion_reappear replay cases before promotion.
